api: SourceCacheStats { charged_bytes: usize, capacity_bytes: usize, occupied_bytes: usize, hits: u64, misses: u64, evictions: u64 }

semantics.default: Disabled; max_bytes=0 drops cache and removes its modeled charge.
semantics.positive_budget: Remote generation only; must admit at least one full-width 256-row slot plus all overhead. No fixed product cap.
semantics.identity: No shared entries; contained immutable generation owns root SHA/source location/ETag/PageAuthority. Every reopen starts empty.
semantics.mapping: Direct mapped: slot = source_block_id % slot_count. Partial final block uses actual authenticated object tail bytes.
semantics.fetching: Keep full original source cover/admission. Skip an original planned range only if every block is cached. Fetch all remaining original ranges unchanged through sq8_s3_range::fetch_verified_ranges_inner; preserve concurrency, ordered errors and draining.
semantics.failure: Failed fetch batch inserts no entries (even successful sibling responses are discarded by the shared fetcher); shared source charges preserved, no subsequent SQ8.
semantics.counters: hits/misses count original ranges; evictions count replaced blocks; occupied_bytes excludes padding. Cache observations are cumulative, not per-query or billed/network requests.
semantics.timing: Lookup, copy, miss fetch, insertion and original-order reassembly remain inside source stage.
semantics.concurrency: One std mutex across tag verification and owned range copying; released before await. Queries never borrow/cache-slice a larger allocation.
semantics.tests: Single new parameterized regression uses existing paged-source fixture at rows=513, dimensions=2 and 5; old disabled negatives remain.

formulas.S: min(P, floor((max_bytes - F) / (B + size_of::<usize>()))) ; reject max_bytes<F or S=0
formulas.occupied_bytes: sum(min(B, object_bytes - block_id*B)) over valid slot tags
formulas.generation_model: old_modeled_memory - previous_cache_C + C; checked against total limits.max_memory_bytes before cache allocations
formulas.retired_pins: Prior generations keep their cache/model until dropped. Subsequent open's already_pinned_bytes includes prior model; regression covers one-byte-under rejection and exact admitted coexistence.
formulas.existing_source_payload: 2 * min(limits.max_source_bytes, source_object_bytes) * A remains charged independently; hit copies + miss fetch buffers fit original full cover.
formulas.allocation_note: Two fixed boxed allocations; no growth/LRU. Explicit modeled 64-byte allowance per allocation and query vector plus control/capacity sizes; allocator/transport RSS still requires native qualification.

coverage: disabled/empty/full hit/mixed blocks in original full range
mixed whole-range hit and miss with original ordered reassembly
one-slot eviction and partial tail at two dimensions
two concurrent admitted queries, reconciled source read counts and verified bytes
wrong response ETag/corrupt payload/delayed failing miss, drain and exact charges
no insertion on failed batch/no poisoned entries/no SQ8 after source failure
insufficient cache budget/total memory before requests; full-cover admission on warm hits
reopen isolation/disable charge removal/old-current pinned coexistence
literal full warmed original-range byte oracle; deterministically coordinated spawned collision while full-block hit bytes remain live
